desc: The jumbo SHRIMP by Q uses their Quickie Fast-Attach design with precision shooters in mind. Short, lightweight, and hearing safe, this is a silencer for those who prefer a more compact platform, or who don't want unnecessary length added to their favorite precision bolt gun. The jumbo SHRIMP is made up of 100% titanium with a PVD coating, fully rotary welded with no outer tube (more internal volume), and features standard size wrench flats on the front and back for easy install and removal.
